description: This file contains shell script tests for verifying the handling of transitive info/alternate entries in Git repositories. It sets up multiple repositories, manipulates alternates, and checks for correctness of alternate object path enumeration and recursion.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a condition and expects it to succeed, used to define the test steps.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.
